text: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizensholding a valid foreign passport.If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant should have foreign nationality at birth and hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, a record of more than 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country in the last 4 years (by April 30, 2025)is also needed. For people immigrating fromChinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above.Applicants should bephysically and mentally healthy, and meet the medical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit in China.Age Limit and Education Background Requirements:(1)Undergraduate students: under the age of 30, with a diploma comparable to the High School Diploma in China..(2)Master’sstudents: under the age of 35, with a degree comparable to the Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese universities.(3)Doctoral students: under the age of 40, with a degree comparable to the Master’s Degree in Chinese universities.(4) General Scholar: under the age of 45, with a degree comparable to the Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese universities.(5) Senior Scholar: under the age of 50, with a degree comparable to the Master’s Degree in Chinese universities.4. Applicants should have excellent gradesand good conduct,without any record of violation of school rules and regulations, nor any record of public security punishmentor criminal record.5. Applicants shouldhave excellent grades and clear purpose of studyingin China, with aGPA of 3.0 or above in the previous academic yearwithoutfailing or repeated subjects.6. LanguageProficiency Requirements:(1) Master’s /Doctoral ProgramsChinese Medium Program:Applicantsmust reach a score above 180 in HSK 5or provide other comparable certificates proving Chinese proficiency.English Medium Program:Applicantsfrom non-English-speaking countries must reach a score above 90 in TOEFL(20 or above for each item) or 6.5 in IELTS(6.0 or above for each item); or provide other comparable certificates proving English proficiency. Applicants from English-speaking countriesor receiving the last degree with the instruction in English are exempt from submitting the English proficiency certificates, but the certificate of English medium issued by the school graduated from shall be provided.
